purpose: Machine-readable W10 tranche closure state. Consumed by tests/test_l_series_prerequisite_lock.py which fails if any L-series file exists while any W10 tranche is not closed. Update ONLY as part of the commit that closes each tranche.

W10-1.summary: Real tokenizer and corpus training path in the GUI worker (aeon/job/data_source.py; fail-closed factory; audit findings A1/A2/A3 flipped)

W10-2.summary: Protected checkpoint integration in the GUI worker (aeon/job/key_store.py; worker calls protected_save/protected_load; per-job HMAC; A4/A5 flipped)

W10-3.summary: Distinct Start / Resume / Recovery flows (Job.intent field; aeon/launcher/resume.py enumeration; start-refuses-active-chain; A6 flipped)

W10-4.summary: Atomic per-generation checkpoint chain with COMPLETE marker (aeon/job/generation.py; worker uses generation_save + discard_incomplete + latest_authorized_generation; A16 flipped)

W10-5.summary: Frozen release provenance via embedded RELEASE_METADATA (aeon/checkpoint.py source_commit_id + SourceCommitUnavailable; A15 flipped)

W10-6.summary: Full-bundle runtime integrity: manifest schema v2, top-level Aeon.exe/python311.dll enumerated with scope=top_level, trust_root recorded, malformed entries fail closed, path traversal rejected, installed-tree walk rejects unlisted .exe/.dll/.pyd/.yaml/.json (A9/A10/A11 flipped)

W10-7.summary: Installer correctness: SourceDir=..\.. pins [Files] Source, PrepareToInstall verifies manifest SHA-256 against RUNTIME_MANIFEST.sha256 sidecar (generator emits it), upgrade guard blocks on RUNNING/STARTING/STOP_REQUESTED/CHECKPOINTING, CloseApplications=force removed (A12/A13/A14 flipped)

W10-8.summary: Fail-closed frozen preflight: in frozen mode (sys.frozen / _MEIPASS) missing or unloadable tokenizer/corpus BLOCKS instead of WARN; corpus check now attempts to read one text record via iter_text_records; source-tree mode preserves WARN (A17 flipped)

W10-9.summary: Real desktop operations + real metrics: worker consumes cpu_thread_limit/memory_ceiling_gb/validation_interval from Job.compute_policy and applies them (torch.set_num_threads, safe-stop on ceiling, periodic in-worker validation writing worker_validation.jsonl). Metrics computed via perf_counter — no more step_time_s=0.0 placeholders. GUI Validate runs --diagnose against the latest authenticated checkpoint with subprocess.run(capture_output=True) into a scrollable text window. GUI Diagnose captures output identically. GUI Recovery enumerates authenticated candidates via aeon.launcher.resume.enumerate_checkpoints, builds the RecoveryDecision in-process via BuildableRecoveryDecision, and spawns intent=recover. A7/A8/A18/A19/A20 flipped.

W10-10.summary: Build reproducibility + real licences + attestation handling: requirements-windows.lock now uses exact == pins for every runtime and build-tool dependency (no >= or < ranges); windows-release.yml and windows-certification.yml pin all actions/* references to 40-char commit SHAs (with vX.Y.Z comment tags); build.ps1 throws when packaging/windows/licences/ is missing, empty, PLACEHOLDER-only, or missing any required upstream LICENSE (torch/pyinstaller/sentencepiece/safetensors/numpy/pyyaml); attest step uses continue-on-error and records attestation_status=ATTESTED or ATTESTATION_NOT_AVAILABLE_FOR_CURRENT_PLAN so private-repo builds succeed without a GHEC-only attestation (A21/A22/A23/A25 flipped)

W10-11.summary: End-to-end certification against a bounded English fixture: real SentencePiece tokenizer + real JSONL corpus drive a full Start->Resume->Corrupt->Recover lifecycle; asserts non-zero perf_counter metrics (W10-9), periodic worker_validation.jsonl evidence (W10-9), authenticated per-generation envelope round-trip through Resume (W10-2, W10-3, W10-4), tamper detection on the newest generation (W10-2, W10-6), authorized rollback via BuildableRecoveryDecision moving forward generations into <ck>/.discarded/ for evidence, and post-rollback enumeration containing only authenticated candidates. Also adds worker rollback-cleanup helper _discard_generations_after and fixes a pre-existing double-save bug at max_steps==ckpt_every boundary. Closes W10 — L-series prerequisite gate unlocks.

l_series_gate.unlocks_when: every tranche in .tranches is closed=true (W10-0.1 counts too, though it is only the governance commit)
l_series_gate.reason: L-series measurements against a worker that trains on torch.randint synthetic tokens would produce mutual-information and Bayes-factor readings on noise. Every subsequent claim inherits the contamination. See docs/directives/L_SERIES_LATENT_BYPASS_AND_HIDDEN_STATE_EFFICIENCY_UPGRADE.md §1.
